FIELDS.NAME: Priority Ambulance Services
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Chief Operations Officer, Priority Ambulance Services, Phone: (555) 123-4567, Email: john.smith@priorityambulance.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Priority Ambulance Services is dedicated to providing high-quality emergency medical transportation across Springfield and the surrounding regions. Our core operations focus exclusively on the immediate transport of patients to licensed hospital emergency rooms, ensuring compliance with local, state, and federal regulations. Our professional team comprises certified EMTs and paramedics, all of whom maintain current licenses and undergo rigorous background checks prior to employment. We operate a fleet of ambulances that are subject to frequent maintenance and safety inspections, adhering to manufacturer guidelines to guarantee the reliability and safety of our vehicles. Our 24/7 dispatch service enables us to respond rapidly to emergency calls, and we maintain meticulous records of dispatch and patient transports to support compliance and quality assurance. Our commitment to high standards of care is reinforced by a formal quality assurance program and incident reporting system, further demonstrating our dedication to patient safety and care excellence.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2022, our ambulance was involved in a minor accident resulting from a slick road due to unexpected rain. The total cost of repairs amounted to $3,000. The claim was submitted and has been successfully closed. Additionally, on January 5, 2021, we responded to a call where the patient’s transfer caused incidental damage to equipment totaling $2,000, which is also resolved.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Fully secured, UL-listed safe, Class B, with a fire rating of 1 hour; used for storing medical supplies and sensitive documents related to patient care.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and on-site watch services to enhance safety and deter unauthorized access.
